title: Network Pharmacology Approach to Explore the Skin-Lightening Compounds and Potential Mechanisms of Chinese Herbal Medicines.
authors: Liang, Yixuan; Chen, Jing; Fu, Chuhan; Dai, Xixia; Jiang, Ling; Lei, Xinxin
one_liner_zh: 该文用网络药理学和分子对接研究中药美白化合物，核心是药物-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，无TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: INTRODUCTION: Herbal formulations have been used for skin whitening in China for centuries, yet systematic evaluations of their efficacy and underlying mechanisms remain limited. This study aims to identify potential anti-melanogenic compounds in traditional skin-whitening herbs using network pharmacology and investigate their mechanisms of action. METHODS: The Traditional Chinese Medicine Systems Pharmacology (TCMSP) database was used to screen for anti-melanogenic compounds and their potential targets. A protein-protein interaction (PPI) network was constructed using Cytoscape 3.7.2, followed by KEGG pathway enrichment analysis. The pharmacological effects were assessed in a 3D human skin model, and in vitro experiments were conducted to explore the molecular mechanisms of the identified compounds. RESULTS: Eight potential skin-whitening herbs were identified, including Ampelopsis japonica, Nepeta tenuifolia Benth., Scutellaria baicalensis Georgi, Asarum heterotropoides F. Schmidt, Ipomoea nil, Angelica dahurica, Angelica sinensis, and Prunus persica, along with ten active compounds: quercetin, kaempferol, wogonin, beta-sitosterol, baicalein, stigmasterol, anhydroicaritin, agroclavin, moslosooflavone, and acacetin. Among them, quercetin and acacetin demonstrated significant anti-melanogenic effects in the 3D skin model by downregulating ET-1, VEGF, and PTGS2 in keratinocytes. Molecular docking analysis further revealed strong binding affinities of quercetin and acacetin to TLR4, CHUK, and RELA in the NF-kappaB pathway, suggesting their role in melanogenesis inhibition via suppression of keratinocyte paracrine signaling. CONCLUSIONS: This study highlights the potential of network pharmacology as an effective approach for screening anti-melanogenic compounds from traditional skin-whitening herbs. Quercetin and acacetin were identified as key bioactive compounds that inhibit melanogenesis by modulating keratinocyte signaling pathways.
abstract_zh: 引言：数百年来，中草药配方在中国被用于皮肤美白，然而对其功效及潜在机制的系统性评估仍然有限。本研究旨在通过网络药理学方法，从传统美白中草药中识别潜在的抗黑色素生成化合物，并探讨其作用机制。方法：利用中药系统药理学数据库（TCMSP）筛选抗黑色素生成化合物及其潜在靶点。使用Cytoscape 3.7.2构建蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）网络，随后进行KEGG通路富集分析。在3D人体皮肤模型中评估药理效果，并通过体外实验探究所识别化合物的分子机制。结果：共识别出八种潜在美白中草药，包括白蔹（Ampelopsis japonica）、荆芥（Nepeta tenuifolia Benth.）、黄芩（Scutellaria baicalensis Georgi）、细辛（Asarum heterotropoides F. Schmidt）、牵牛子（Ipomoea nil）、白芷（Angelica dahurica）、当归（Angelica sinensis）和桃仁（Prunus persica），以及十种活性化合物：槲皮素（quercetin）、山奈酚（kaempferol）、汉黄芩素（wogonin）、β-谷甾醇（beta-sitosterol）、黄芩素（baicalein）、豆甾醇（stigmasterol）、脱水淫羊藿素（anhydroicaritin）、麦角克碱（agroclavin）、荠苎黄酮（moslosooflavone）和金合欢素（acacetin）。其中，槲皮素和金合欢素在3D皮肤模型中通过下调角质形成细胞中的ET-1、VEGF和PTGS2，表现出显著的抗黑色素生成效果。分子对接分析进一步揭示了槲皮素和金合欢素与NF-kappaB通路中TLR4、CHUK和RELA的强结合亲和力，提示其通过抑制角质形成细胞旁分泌信号传导来抑制黑色素生成的作用。结论：本研究凸显了网络药理学作为从传统美白中草药中筛选抗黑色素生成化合物的有效方法的潜力。槲皮素和金合欢素被确定为通过调节角质形成细胞信号通路抑制黑色素生成的关键生物活性化合物。
